properties.name: A constructor's loop hint says where the node landed, not where the common case lands
properties.rationale: Root cause: fact:root-cause-add-decisions-lands-proposed-hint-recurred-on-the-one-call-settle-path-2026-09-29 (recorded in the live design; not yet in this branch's export, so named here rather than linked), a recurrence of fact:defect-add-decision-hints-lands-proposed-on-a-write-that-left-it-accepted (2026-08-14). Class: a reply sentence hand-written for the common case and never conditioned on the result it describes. Pinned by crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/a_loop_hint_says_where_the_node_landed.rs, OBSERVED RED on a clean origin/main build (4 of 5 failed; the fifth is regression cover for the case where the claim is true), green on the fix.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: add_decision's loop hint is read from the status the node stands at, so an accepted or merged-over-accepted decision is no longer told it 'lands proposed'. The same fixed-sentence class is swept: add_design_rule no longer asks for `enforced` when the rule states it, and add_capability no longer tells a caller who passed `satisfies` to wire it.
